user.title: Add a MeshCom node
user.description: Enter the IP address of your node. On the node, set 'ext. UDP IP' to the address of Home Assistant and enable 'ext UDP'. Only enable the external UDP interface on nodes that stay in your home network.

data_description.host: Private IPv4 address of the node, for example 192.168.1.50.
data_description.listen_port: The node always sends to port 1799. Only change this if a forwarder sends to another port.

no_packet.title: No packet from the node
no_packet.description: Nothing arrived from {host} on UDP port {port}. Check that 'ext UDP' is enabled on the node and that 'ext. UDP IP' points to Home Assistant, then click 'Send Position' on the node's web page and submit to try again.

progress.wait_for_node: Waiting for a packet from the node at {host} (UDP port {port}). Click 'Send Position' on the node's web page to send one right away.

error.invalid_host: Enter a private IPv4 address, for example 192.168.1.50.

abort.port_unavailable: UDP port {port} could not be opened. Another program may be using it.

port_unavailable.message: UDP port {port} could not be opened. Another program may be using it.
